response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and platforms, but lacks the mandatory C++ development experience on Windows required for this role. While they have some C/C++ experience (e.g., National Instruments, LabWindows/CVI), it is limited and not recent. Their domain expertise is also misaligned, with no clear exposure to capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience with modern languages (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python)
Proven ability to work in diverse technical environments (web, mobile, embedded, AI)
Demonstrated proficiency in CI/CD, testing, and software craftsmanship practices
concerns: Lacks required 5–10 years of recent C++ development on Windows platform
No domain expertise in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking
Limited experience with SQL Server/Oracle (only mentions MongoDB and MySQL)
